facts.fact: Lucia 在 Maxim 桌上找丢失的实验记录与专利申请。
facts.anchor: I couldn’t find my lab book and patent proposal

facts.fact: Maxim 反讽她才是那个「借」东西的人。
facts.anchor: you tend to be the thief here

facts.fact: Maxim 说两家都需要一个了结。
facts.anchor: Both of our families need closure

facts.fact: Dorian 生前是世俗派，希望海葬或林葬，认为葬礼是浪费。
facts.anchor: He wanted to be tossed into the ocean

facts.fact: Maxim 说你不必一个人扛最重的担子。
facts.anchor: you don’t have to be the one with the heaviest shoulders

facts.fact: 她决定不带香水与沐浴，只以自己为筹码再引那兽。
facts.anchor: I had nothing to offer but purely myself

facts.fact: 她心想若今夜被吞，至少能再见到 Dorian。
facts.anchor: at least I may look forward to seeing you again

facts.fact: 黑暗中先出现三点光，巨兽带着 Dorian 的脸出现。
她用香水瓶砸它的脸，伤口却自行愈合。
facts.anchor: I whipped my arm around to bludgeon him

facts.fact: 它自称让星辰保持一臂之距。

facts.fact: 它警告她继续这样会在世界上打开门，放进更坏的东西。
